text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Ideal, constant-drop, and exponential diode models trade detail for simpler analysis

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Passive diode convention: v_D=v_anode−v_cathode, i_D anode→cathode. Constant-drop model assumes0.7 V for conduction; it is not a universal material threshold.
Exponential curve omits series resistance, high injection and reverse breakdown. Ideal off state carries zero current; ideal on state has zero voltage at any
